caseName: Williams & Wilkins Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: WILLIAMS & WILKINS CO v. UNITED STATES
attorneys: Alan Latman argued the cause for petitioner. With him on the briefs were Arthur J. Greenbaum and Martin F. Rickman., Solicitor General Bork argued the cause for the United States. With him on the brief were Assistant Attorney General Hills, Harriet S. Shapiro, and William G. Kanter.*

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is affirmed by an equally divided Court.

Mr. Justice Blackmun took no part in the decision of this case.
